name: Pillar
description: A concrete support pillar sweating rust. Good to hide behind. Bad to hit.

name: Rubble
description: A heap of broken masonry. You can see over it. You can't walk through it without regret.

name: Crate
description: A shipping crate stenciled PROPERTY OF SOMEONE WHO DIED.

name: Barrel
description: A chemical drum with the label scratched off, which is never a good sign.

name: Pipe Cluster
description: A knot of pipes coming up through the floor and going nowhere in particular.

name: Dead Boiler
description: A boiler the size of a hatchback. Cold. Mostly.

name: Lockers
description: A bank of maintenance lockers. One of them is humming.

name: Shopping Cart
description: An overturned shopping cart. It got further from the store than you did.

name: Fridge
description: A break-room fridge, door taped shut. Whatever's in there has been evolving for a while.

name: Chest Freezer
description: A chest freezer humming on a dead circuit. Don't ask how. Don't open it.

name: Washing Machine
description: A coin-op washer, mid-cycle since the end of the world. The water is a color.

name: Dryer
description: A dryer with one sock in it, tumbling forever in a drum that isn't spinning.

name: Stove
description: An industrial stove. Every burner is on. Nothing is plugged in.

name: Dish Sink
description: A double sink piled with somebody's last lunch. The lunch has opinions now.

name: Tool Chest
description: A rolling tool chest, locked. The key is in the crawler who died next to it.

name: Shelf
description: Metal shelving stacked with jars of something. The labels are in a handwriting you don't like.

name: Rack
description: An empty steel rack. It held something heavy once. You can see the dents.

name: File Cabinet
description: A four-drawer file cabinet. Every drawer is labeled PERSONNEL. Every drawer is empty.

name: Workbench
description: A scarred workbench with a vise. Somebody was building something. Then they weren't.

name: Cot
description: A canvas cot with a dent shaped like a person who slept badly for a long time.

name: Chair
description: An office chair with one wheel. It has been spinning slowly since you walked in.

name: Bathtub
description: A clawfoot bathtub, down here, for reasons. There's a ring around it. There's a ring around the ring.

name: Shower
description: A tiled shower stall. The curtain moves when nothing else does.

name: Toilet Stall
description: A bathroom stall, door shut, OCCUPIED. Has been for a year.

name: Sink
description: A cracked porcelain sink. The tap drips in a rhythm that's almost a song.

name: Toilet
description: A toilet with no stall around it, out in the open, judging everyone.

name: Trough Sink
description: A long steel wash trough from a factory restroom. Smells like soap and despair.

name: Urinal
description: A urinal bolted to nothing, standing proud in the middle of the floor.

name: Trash Can
description: An overflowing trash can. Something in it is still warm.

name: Bin Cart
description: A rolling trash bin with a yellow hazard stripe. The hazard is inside.

name: Flatbed Dolly
description: A flatbed dolly, abandoned mid-delivery. Whatever it was carrying walked off on its own.

name: Janitor's Cart
description: A janitor's cart: mop, bucket, three spray bottles. The janitor clocked out permanently.

name: Laundry Cart
description: A canvas laundry cart heaped with sheets. One of the sheets is breathing. Probably a draft.

name: Tool Cart
description: A red rolling tool cart with wrenches laid out like a surgeon's tray. Don't think about that.

name: Utility Cart
description: A two-shelf steel utility cart. Squeaks if you look at it.

name: Wire Basket Cart
description: A wire basket cart, the kind that holds linens. It holds a smell now.

name: Surgical Cart
description: A steel cart laid out with surgical tools and a kidney dish. Someone was mid-procedure. On what is unclear.

name: Food Service Cart
description: A steam-table cart with three empty trays and a stack of plates. Lunch was cancelled forever.

name: Bloody Table
description: A steel table with a lot of dried something on it. The something used to be somebody.

name: Heavy Steel Table
description: A riveted steel table bolted to the floor. Built to survive anything. Did.

name: Steel Table
description: A dented steel work table. Cold to the touch, like everything else down here.

name: Trough Table
description: A steel table with a drain lip all the way around. You don't want to know what drains.

name: Folding Table
description: A folding table from a church basement. It has seen potlucks. It has seen worse since.

name: Small Table
description: A rusted little side table. Holds nothing, supports nobody, blocks you anyway.

name: Office Desk
description: A wooden office desk. Every drawer has a stapler in it. Nobody knows why.

name: Vise Workbench
description: A heavy workbench with a red vise. Somebody clamped something in it and left in a hurry.

name: Table and Stools
description: A bolted-down food court table with four stools. Reserved, apparently, for ghosts.

name: Concrete Bench
description: A concrete bench designed by people who hated loitering. Now it's cover.

name: Steel Bench
description: A slatted steel bench. Leaves a grid on your thighs and your soul.

name: Park Bench
description: A park bench, far from any park. The plaque says IN LOVING MEMORY and the name is scratched out.

name: Wood Bench
description: A plain wooden bench. Splinters included at no extra cost.

name: Padded Bench
description: A vinyl waiting-room bench, cracked and taped. Something waited here a long time.

name: Sludge
description: Ankle-deep sump water with a skin on it. Slows you down. Doesn't otherwise judge.

name: Steam Vent
description: A floor vent coughing scalding steam on a schedule only it knows.

name: Live Wire
description: A severed cable lying in a puddle, which is the worst place for either of them.

name: Gas Leak
description: A cracked line hissing something green. Breathe through your mouth. Actually, don't.

name: Rust Spikes
description: A grate with its bolts sheared off, all points up. Tetanus as a design language.

name: Caltrops
description: Jacks, nails and spite scattered across the floor. Whoever steps here will remember it.

name: Tacks
description: A box of thumbtacks, all of them face up. Office supplies, weaponized.

name: Barbed Wire
description: A coil of barbed wire. It doesn't want you to pass. It's very clear about it.

name: Broken Glass
description: Bottle glass, ground fine by a thousand feet. Some of them were bare.

name: Marbles
description: Ball bearings and marbles rolling around underfoot. Great for cartoons. Bad for ankles.

name: Oil Slick
description: A slick of something that used to be lotion, or motor oil, or both.

name: Glue
description: A puddle of industrial superglue. Step in it once. Only once, because you'll be there a while.

name: Fire
description: Burning fuel spreading across the floor. It is very much on fire.

name: Smoke
description: A cloud of greasy smoke. Nobody sees through it. Nobody aims through it.

name: Trip Wire
description: A wire strung ankle-high across the floor. Invisible, if you're the one walking.
